transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I suppose I'm here because of my evenings. I just... I keep having these nights where I stop and get a family-size takeout order on the way home. And then I'll add chips, or maybe some bakery things from the store. And I just eat most of it myself. It's like I don't even register how much is gone until it's too late.
Do you feel like you're in control of how much you're eating during those nights?

No. Not really. It's... I don't know. Once I start, it's like this awful switch flips. I can be sitting there thinking, Taylor, put it away... but my hands just keep opening the containers anyway. It's like I'm not the one in charge.
Do these nights where you eat a lot happen regularly or is it a rare occurrence?
It's... pretty regular. I keep a little journal, and... well, looking back at it, there's barely been a week in the last several months where it didn't happen. Most weeks it's... several times.
How do you feel after one of these episodes of eating a lot by yourself?
I just... I feel awful. It's embarrassing. I don't really want to talk about how I feel afterward, to be honest. It's just bad.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a lot by yourself?
I... I don't know. Like I said, I just feel bad. I don't really want to get into all the specific words for it. I just try to move on and not dwell on it.
Do you think you would stop eating if someone walked into the room while you were having one of these episodes?

I... I don't know if I could. Probably not. It's... well, once I start, it's like this awful switch flips. I can be sitting there thinking, Taylor, just put it away, but... my hands just keep opening containers anyway. It's like I'm not even the one in charge.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these episodes?

I guess so. Um... yeah. I don't really taste anything when it happens. I'm usually just... standing there at the dining room table, with the boxes and the microwave. I just... swallow a bite and I'm already reaching for the next one. So, yes, it's fast.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a lot by yourself?
I think you already asked me that... and like I said, I just feel bad. I don't really want to talk about how I feel afterward. I just try to forget it happened.
Do you usually try to eat these large amounts of food alone, without others knowing?

Yes. I... I make a point to be alone. I usually wait until my husband is asleep. Or... well, if the contractors are working on the house, I wait until they're gone. 

I just... I would be mortified if anyone saw the amount I can put away. Especially after I spend all day at work being so... controlled. So, yes, I make sure no one is around.
Do you think you usually eat this way when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
I'm not really sure. I don't... I haven't really noticed if it's tied to being upset or anything. I don't really spend time thinking about my feelings before it happens. It just happens.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you start during these episodes?

Yes... I suppose so. It's... once I start, there's just this switch that flips. I can be sitting there thinking, you know, Taylor, put it away... but my hands just keep opening containers anyway. It's like I'm not even the one in charge.
Do you feel like you're unable to control what you're eating during these episodes because you're hungry or because you just can't stop yourself?
I don't think it's hunger. I... I just can't stop.
Do you feel like you're unable to control your eating during these episodes because something is driving you to continue, even if you want to stop?

Yeah. Um... like I was saying before, I... I do want to stop. I'll be sitting there telling myself to just put it away. But... my hands just keep going anyway. It really just feels like I'm not the one in charge anymore. I don't know what else to call it.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or disconnected from what's happening while you're eating during these episodes?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I know what's happening. I'm right there. I just... can't stop it, like I said.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating are over?
I... I don't know. I guess so. I mean, I just feel bad about it. But I try not to really think about it once it's done.
Do you recall what you were thinking or feeling right before one of these episodes started?
I... I'm not really sure. I don't think I'm focusing on anything in particular. I just... I haven't really noticed what I'm feeling right before. It just sort of starts.
Do you feel like you're eating even if you're not hungry during these episodes?

I suppose so. I mean... a lot of the time I'm not actually hungry. Like, I might have already eaten a full dinner. But later on... I just find myself looking through the pantry or the fridge. It's like... I just feel like I have to finish something.
Do these episodes of eating a lot by yourself happen more often when you're feeling stressed or upset?
I... I couldn't really say. I mean, work is always a bit much, but... I haven't really noticed a connection. I don't really pay attention to my moods like that. It just... happens.
Do you think these episodes of eating a lot by yourself ever happen when you're feeling calm and relaxed?
I'm not really sure about that either. I don't really keep track of whether I'm relaxed or not. It's just... it happens when it happens. I haven't noticed a pattern.
